item.title: Skyrim's Most Iconic Region Is Making a Major Comeback
item.description: Winter is coming to Tamriel, and The Elder Scrolls Online is preparing to take players somewhere particularly familiar. One of the most memorable regions from The Elder Scrolls 5: Skyrim is making its way to the MMORPG, giving fans another reason to revisit the icy northern reaches of the continent.

item.title: Magic: The Gathering Designer Reveals the Biggest Problem With Marvel’s Infinity Stones
item.description: When Magic: The Gathering ‘s Marvel’s Spider-Man set launched in 2025, the inclusion of The Soul Stone hinted at the scope of Wizards of the Coast’s partnership with Marvel . Including one of the six cosmically powerful gems as the set’s headliner card practically guaranteed the rest would eventually be released, a plan that was confirmed with the printing of The Mind Stone in the 2026 Marvel Super Heroes set. It’s a clever strategy, but one that Magic head game designer Mark Rosewater told Polygon demonstrates a problem with Universes Beyond design.

item.title: 2026’s Best-Sci Fi Movie Is Officially Returning to IMAX
item.description: Sometimes a movie's spectacle is so great that it really does need to be experienced in a theater, preferably in the best possible format available to you . Project Hail Mary , this year's stunning Andy Weir adaptation starring Ryan Gosling, is one such movie. It may have been difficult to catch in IMAX, however, as IMAX screens are a hot commodity and the film has been out of theaters for a while. If you missed it the first time around, Amazon MGM Studios has an end-of-year treat for you.

item.title: GTA 6 Withholds Your 100% Stats Until the End — For Good Reason
item.description: Completionists beware: Grand Theft Auto 6 is going to take you a very, very long time to complete. Rockstar Game’s open-world game is filled to the brim with things to do, see, and collect. You can go golfing, collect undersea treasures, find collectible trading cards, rack up medals at shooting ranges, scan landmarks, and so much more. Rockstar knows that it could get overwhelming fast, so GTA 6 was designed to combat that in one key way.

item.title: Goodbye, Lucia: GTA 6 Fans' Official New Obsession Is Mandy
item.description: Less than 24 hours ago, social media posts about Grand Theft Auto 6 were flooded with thirsty images of Lucia Caminos, the first female protagonist in Rockstar's open-world series. Now that the game is playable in some regions of the world , much of that enthusiasm has transferred to an entirely new character who hasn't appeared in any of the game's screenshots or marketing. Meet Mandy, GTA 6 's new it girl.

item.title: DMZ key and locations in Modern Warfare 4
item.description: There are loads of DMZ keys in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 . Used to open both locked containers and locked doors, keys are your fast-track to getting your hands on some of the best loot the extraction mode has to offer. However, when you receive a key, you're only given a brief description of where to use it, so we're going to outline where you can use every key the game has to offer.

item.title: GTA 6's Subscription-based Perks are Worrying Players
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 has finally arrived to critical acclaim . Millions of players purchased their copies a while ago, and preorders came with a free month of GTA Plus , Rockstar's monthly subscription service. It now offers exclusive benefits in GTA 6 's single-player campaign, including a new car, a garage, discounts, and other gameplay bonuses.

item.title: GTA 6 Is Already Breaking Twitch Records
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is already rewriting streaming history. Rockstar Games' highly anticipated sequel has attracted 3.29 million concurrent viewers on Twitch, breaking the platform's previous record for a video game launch as its global rollout continues.

item.title: GTA 6 Won’t Be Getting a Future Performance Mode, Even on PS5 Pro
item.description: In a rough turn of events for frame rate diehards, it seems Grand Theft Auto 6 won’t get a patch that boosts its frame rate at the expense of graphical fidelity. Speaking with Kotaku , Rockstar confirmed the game will not receive a performance mode on modern consoles, even on the beefier PlayStation 5 Pro.
